compute_conv_output_size: compute the output spatial size of a sparse convolution given kernel, stride, padding, and dilation parameters
compute_deconv_output_size: compute the output spatial size of a sparse transposed convolution given kernel, stride, padding, dilation, and output padding
build_indice_pairs: build indice pairs for sparse convolution by dispatching to 2D, 3D, or 4D CUDA kernels based on tensor dimensionality
run_indice_conv: run a sparse indice convolution on features and filters with fp32 or fp16 precision support
run_indice_maxpool: run a sparse indice max pooling operation on features using fp32 or fp16 precision kernels
